response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_hgb FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall_hgb FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_hgb) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, avg_hgb - overall_hgb AS above_overall, avg_hgb - AVG(avg_hgb) OVER () AS above_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
